verdict.rationale: The pricing page lists "Attorney Review — Included", so some licensed-attorney involvement is claimed. Other pages describe preparation only as "our team" working with you. Nothing names lawyers, describes an attorney-of-record model, or says attorneys prepare and sign the filing rather than just review it. Missing for 10: named attorneys or bar credentials, a stated attorney-of-record/filing model, evidence that attorneys prepare the petition, and independent corroboration.
